title: Apple releases security updates
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-374.11.16.20: TT-CSIRT ADVISORY – Apple Releases Security Updates
leadParagraph: Apple has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in multiple products.
contentHtml:
Apple has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in multiple products.

An attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to take control of an affected system. Some of these vulnerabilities have been detected in exploits in the wild.

It is encouraged that users and administrators, review the Apple security pages and apply the necessary updates.

For further information and support, please visit the links below:
macOS Big Sur 11.0, 11.0.1
macOS High Sierra 10.13.6, macOS Mojave 10.14.6
